Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\plain.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\with space.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\hash#and%percent.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 4
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\caf" & ChrW(233) & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 5
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\a&b+c.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
    s = Replace(wb.FullName, folder, "<folder>") & "|" & Replace(wb.FullNameURLEncoded, folder, "<folder>")
    s = s & "|" & (wb.FullName = wb.FullNameURLEncoded)
    wb.Close False
    Tried = s
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 5
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
